name: SteelWheels XMLA EMEA Classic Cars validation
description: Strict XMLA/eMondrian Q1-Q6 counterpart of the SteelWheels SQL Direct scenario. Uses Mondrian-valid Descendants(...) syntax for monthly 2004 queries.

queries.label: SW XMLA Q1 — ALLOW Sales by month
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, Descendants([Time].[Years].[2004], [Time].[Months]) ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Classic Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[EMEA])

queries.label: SW XMLA Q2 — ALLOW Quantity by month
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Quantity]} ON COLUMNS, Descendants([Time].[Years].[2004], [Time].[Months]) ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Classic Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[EMEA])

queries.label: SW XMLA Q3 — BLOCK APAC instead of EMEA
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, Descendants([Time].[Years].[2004], [Time].[Months]) ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Classic Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[APAC])

queries.label: SW XMLA Q4 — BLOCK Motorcycles instead of Classic Cars
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, Descendants([Time].[Years].[2004], [Time].[Months]) ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Motorcycles], [Markets].[Territory].[EMEA])

queries.label: SW XMLA Q5 — BLOCK Year grain instead of Month grain
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, {[Time].[Years].[2004]} ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Classic Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[EMEA])

queries.label: SW XMLA Q6 — BLOCK redundant Sales after Q1
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, Descendants([Time].[Years].[2004], [Time].[Months]) ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Classic Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[EMEA])
